facts.text: Maria expressed support for John's efforts, stating that his work is satisfying and worthwhile.

evidence.quote: Agreed, John! Yeah, it can be tough, but it's really satisfying and worthwhile. Keep it up!
Way to go, John! You're really showing dedication and commitment. Gaining first-hand experience and working to find solutions is awesome!

facts.text: John thanked Maria for her support, indicating that her encouragement is meaningful to him.

evidence.quote: Maria, thanks a lot! Your support is really encouraging - I appreciate having you in my corner!
Thanks Maria! It's important to me to put my words into action and find solutions.

facts.text: Maria offered to assist John if needed, emphasizing their collaborative relationship.

evidence.quote: No problem, John. Let me know if you need any help. We work well together!
Thanks, Maria! Will do. Working together would be great!

facts.text: John acknowledged the previous volunteering experience with Maria, recalling the positive impact of their actions.

evidence.quote: Remember when we volunteered together last year? It was such a fulfilling experience.
Yeah, I remember that! It was cool to see how our actions can make a big impact.
